data.action: 躺椅上递防晒霜别脸傲娇，肩头微红发梢滴水
data.camera: medium shot, lounging under parasol, pool sparkle, tsundere mood
data.description: 【避暑山庄泳池·午后】白色的泳装连衣裙下是精心挑选的素雅比基尼，辉夜坐在遮阳伞下的躺椅上，把防晒霜递给你的时候别着脸——「泳、泳装有什么好看的……但是晒伤了就失礼了，所以……勉为其难让你涂吧。」白皙的肩膀在阳光下泛着微红，折叠马尾的发梢滴着水珠，大小姐的第一次度假笨拙又可爱。
data.lighting: 炽白阳光与泳池水光反射
data.promptProse: Shinomiya Kaguya lounges on a deck chair beneath a parasol at the villa poolside, a white swim dress draped over her carefully chosen modest bikini. She holds out a bottle of sunscreen with her face turned away, muttering that sunburn would be improper so you may apply it, her fair shoulders already flushed pink and the tips of her folded ponytail dripping pool water. Bright sunlight dances across the water behind her. Medium shot, cinematic lighting, detailed poolside background.
data.title: 四宫辉夜 · 泳池畔的千金休暇·「泳装有什么好看的，哼」
